# Ninai

Ninai is a local-first, user-owned memory and permission layer for AI tools.

## Canonical pages
- Home: https://ninai.io/
- Install: https://ninai.io/install/
- Research: https://ninai.io/research/
- Privacy: https://ninai.io/privacy/

## Core product facts
- The MVP stores memory in a local SQLite database.
- It exposes memory through MCP.
- Recall is filtered by explicit per-client scopes.
- Returned context packets include provenance and a token budget.
- The full vault stays local, but released context is sent to the selected AI provider.
- Automatic capture currently targets Claude Code PostToolUse hooks.
- The MVP is not production encrypted or independently audited.
